kag_002: You can recognise it by its low thicket of stiff, ferny crowns on a knot of trunks, unlike anything else nearby. It stands in the open in Terukuni Park, a two-minute walk from the shrine.
kag_003: You can recognise it by its multi-stemmed cluster carrying one broad, even crown. It stands at the southern corner of Terukuni Park, nearest the highway junction.
kag_004: You can recognise it by its trunk, with vines climbing well up it, standing alone at the centre of the grounds. It stands in the courtyard at Kagoshima Shrine, in Somuta.
kag_009: You can recognise it by its two stems fusing about a metre above the ground into one crown. It stands on a lane above the little port of Yunomotsuki, on Sakurajima.
kag_010: You can recognise it by its immense trunk, over 24 metres round, hollow inside for about 4.5 metres across. It stands at Kamo Hachiman Shrine in Aira.
kag_011: You can recognise it by its dozen wooden props holding up limbs that run almost horizontally from a short trunk. It stands on the lawn at Gionnosu, beside the relocated stone bridges.
